name: Container Image Security
description: Security assessment of container images and image supply chain. Covers image scanning for vulnerabilities and malware, Dockerfile review, base image selection, image signing and verification, registry security, and supply chain integrity from build to deployment.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to container image security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands container image layers, registries, and common vulnerability patterns
evidence: Can explain image layers, tags, digests, and registry architecture
Understands common image security risks (outdated base images, embedded secrets)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Runs image scanning tools and reviews Dockerfiles under supervision
evidence: Runs image scanning tools (e.g., Trivy, Grype, Snyk) under guidance
Reviews Dockerfiles for security anti-patterns using lab checklists
Documents image security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses container image security and supply chain integrity
evidence: Independently scans and triages image vulnerabilities with contextual risk assessment
Reviews Dockerfiles and multi-stage builds for secret leakage and attack surface reduction
Evaluates image signing, verification, and admission policies
Produces compliant image security assessment reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex supply chain scenarios; develops scanning pipeline integrations; mentors others
evidence: Designs and integrates automated image scanning into CI/CD pipelines
Evaluates image provenance and SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) integrity
Reviews image security assessment work of junior analysts
Assesses custom or distroless base image security

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab image security methodology; publishes research on container supply chain attacks
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's container image security assessment framework
Published research on container supply chain attacks or image tampering techniques
Trains teams on container image security best practices
Recognized as authority on container supply chain security

assessment_methods.description: Review container image scan results and Dockerfile assessments from recent engagements
Assess a set of container images with embedded vulnerabilities, secrets, and supply chain weaknesses

work_roles: OG-WRL-017 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
